verdict.rationale: The docs cover all three channels in the story. Plugin marketplaces are catalogs for distributing plugins, with version tracking, automatic updates, and git-repo or local sources, and anyone with access can install from them with one command. Plugins are documented for sharing with teammates, and project-scoped skills live at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; the API also offers workspace-private uploaded skills. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of team-wide marketplace or repo distribution, and explicit docs on committing project skills to version control for team sharing (implied by the project path, not stated).
